board: TCRT5000 IR line tracking sensor module (common blue 4-pin LM393 clone board: VCC, GND, DO, AO)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test "Surface: white" with the active toggle on, PCB DRC clean, footprint, LCSC). Modelled as a digital-sensor with active-low DO (phototransistor collector with 10k pull-up feeds LM393 + input, trimmer on - input, so reflection pulls DO low); AO is an optional pin not driven in the sim.
breakoutPinoutSource: Module schematic with CON4 header VCC, GND, DO, AO: https://easyelecmodule.com/wp-content/uploads/TCRT5000-Sensor-Module-Circuit-Diagram-1.jpg; same order in https://leobot.net/Tutorial/1084 and the Shillehtek manual
